headline: Confagricoltura, Unapol and Assofrantoi warn: olive growing close to collapse
summary: Confagricoltura, Unapol and Assofrantoi warn that Italy's olive sector faces one of its most serious crises in recent history, a few weeks before the new olive oil season starts.
why: Olive oil is a major agricultural commodity for Italy and Spain, and supply conditions in the harvest season shape producer incomes and prices for food companies.
